# Run ledger — P26.10 (procurement-portal tenants: BidNet, Bonfire, OpenGov, Socrata)

## Spec / Base / Branch / Config

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P26.10__procurement-portal-tenants.md` (SOURCES.9) —
  the multi-tenant registry pattern applied to *purchasing*: BidNet Direct /
  Periscope agency storefronts (`*.bidnetdirect.com`), Bonfire portals
  (`*.bonfirehub.com`), OpenGov Procurement (`procurement.opengov.com`), and
  per-city Socrata contract/award datasets. ≥10 tenants enumerated with
  provenance; surveillance-relevant `procurement_notice` / `content_term`
  claims emitted from captured RFP/award/contract records where rights permit.
- **Branch:** `devin/p26-10-procurement-portals` — stacked on
  `devin/p26-9-camera-registry-expansion` (PR #101).
- **Date:** 2026-09-18. Same GCP posture as P26.8/P26.9: user account
  `14stevevitali@gmail.com` authenticated and authorized on
  `zeta-medley-508121-u7`; per-job upserts (`gcloud run jobs deploy` / IAM
  binding / `gcloud scheduler jobs create|update`), never
  `scheduled-ops.sh --apply`. Local Docker daemon was unresponsive this
  session, so the hosted image was built with **Cloud Build**
  (`gcloud builds submit`) — the same `ops/Dockerfile`, built remotely for
  linux/amd64 and pushed to Artifact Registry.

## Recon findings (live, 2026-09-17/18)

| surface | verdict |
|---|---|
| BidNet Direct storefronts | **strongest surface** — public open/closed/awarded-bid index pages, `?keywords=` server-side filter, public detail pages with full descriptions; robots `User-agent: *` allowed, `Crawl-delay: 5`, AI-scraper UAs blocked, `sort`/`page`/`pageSize`/`jsessionid` query params disallowed (detail `purchasingGroupId`/`origin` params are not) |
| Bonfire (`*.bonfirehub.com`) | robots `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /` on every probed tenant (laurier, columbus) — a platform-wide refusal, recorded |
| OpenGov (`procurement.opengov.com`) | every `/portal/<slug>` answered HTTP 403 `cf-mitigated: challenge` (10 slugs); `/robots.txt` returns the SPA shell — challenge recorded, never defeated |
| Socrata contract datasets | documented `/resource/<id>.json` rows API; per-dataset licence metadata on `/api/views` — 4 resolved-clear (Austin PUBLIC_DOMAIN, SF PDDL, KCMO CC0-1.0, NYC PUBLIC_DOMAIN), Chicago carries none (gated) |

## What landed

### 1. Tenant registry — 17 tenants + platform census

`connectors/src/connectors/data/procurement_portal_tenants.toml` (new, ~457
lines): **9 BidNet** purchasing-group tenants (TX/NY/MD/OK statewide groups +
Bexar/Cameron/Albany/Broome/Lawton/Tulsa-Co/OK-Co/Montgomery-Co verified with
`purchasingGroupId` provenance), **5 Socrata** city datasets (Austin 84ih-p28j,
SF cqi5-hm2d, KCMO c46m-hv6s, NYC dg92-zbpx CROL, Chicago rsxa-ify5 gated),
**2 Bonfire** + **1 OpenGov** gated tenants, and `platform_census` rows
enumerating further hosts without wiring them.

### 2. Connector — `procurement.py` (+~900 lines)

- `portal_targets(source_id=)` — BidNet tenants expand to open/closed/awarded
  index windows plus reviewed keyword windows (`?keywords=` is allowed;
  `?page=` is robots-disallowed, so page-1 only); Socrata tenants expand to one
  bounded SoQL slice (`$limit=500&$order=<reviewed date field> DESC`); gated
  Bonfire/OpenGov tenants expand to the portal URL so each run records the
  refusal/challenge honestly.
- `_parse_portal_index` — BidNet `mets-table-row`/`solicitation-link` markup
  contract; **fail-closed drift** when neither an item nor the
  `id="solicitationList"` container is present; an empty list is an honest
  `empty` outcome. Socrata decodes to a JSON **array** — an object (the SoQL
  error envelope answers HTTP 200) or undecodable body is `ContentDrift`.
  Bonfire/OpenGov bodies are drift *by construction* (no reviewed markup
  contract — their live outcomes are refusal/challenge, never a fabricated
  parse).
- `_discover_portal_documents` — BidNet index items resolve bounded detail-page
  continuations: the detail URL is ALWAYS the item's own
  `solicitation-link` href (never constructed), tier-0 = title matches the
  reviewed surveillance vocabulary, then canonical date order, `doc_per_tenant`
  / `doc_run_cap` bounds riding the target rows, dedupe on detail URL.
- `_normalize_portal_notice` — each item/row → a `procurement_notice` subject +
  surface claims (external_id, notice_type verbatim, posted_date,
  response_deadline, buyer w/ candidate id, document). Lifecycle transitions
  map ONLY through the reviewed `notice_map` — "Award"→`awarded`,
  "Solicitation"→`rfp_issued`; unmapped NYC types ("Notice", "Public Comment",
  "Intent to Award") assert no transition (§3.1).
- `_socrata_record_rows` — the row IS the document: a `portal_document`
  outcome row per record (matched/no_match/empty), a `document` claim with a
  `Locator.row` locator into the captured array, and `content_term` claims
  whose `evidence.locator` is a byte range into the NAMED field
  (`evidence.field` + `record_row`) — verbatim literals verified by
  construction.
- `_normalize_portal_document` — BidNet detail pages → doc outcome row +
  verbatim `content_term` claims (byte-range locators), Part VIII suppressions
  recorded never emitted.

### 3. Vocabulary / registry / plumbing

- `agenda_content_vocab.toml` — reviewed-term additions observed in the real

- `procurement_vocab.toml` — version `2026.09.18-p26.10`; `portal_index`

  portal sources; `[platform_endpoints.bidnet]`/`.socrata` (markup contract,

- `sources.toml` — +6 rows (`bonfire` + 5 `procportal_*`); 4 GL-GATE-06 flips
  (`public_terms_only` + `MIRROR` custody + rights packets verbatim); the four
  blocked surfaces keep named blockers — bidnet terms uncaptured, bonfire
  robots `Disallow:/`, opengov WAF challenge, chicago no licence metadata.
- `live_targets.toml` + `live_targets.py` — `procurement_portal_tenants` kind;
  `runner.py` CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE + `portal_document` outcomes into
  `document_outcomes`; `live_dispositions.toml` stale rows removed;
  `api_allowlist.toml` +Socrata `/resource/` rows (`counsel_reviewed=false`,

### 4. Tests + fixtures

`tests/connectors/test_procurement_portals.py` — 30 tests over committed
fixtures (real captured BidNet index/detail/empty pages, a 5-row verbatim NYC
CROL slice, synthetic drift, captured Bonfire/OpenGov shells): registry
loading, per-source expansion, URL dedupe, reviewed bounds, verbatim field
preservation, notice-type mapping, zero-match/empty honesty, drift fail-closed
on both platforms, gated-surface drift-by-construction, loader-gate refusals,
live-target + allowlist plumbing. `test_review_status.py` counts bumped
(180→186 registered, 61→65 loadable).

`us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/zeta-medley-508121-u7/sig/sig-api:latest`
(digest `sha256:7087ca4bfc04580dafc5706a502e14fd97faba5d74b46a7c1bfcee01850e4d11`,

## Spine before/after

Measured on the hosted PG spine (`sig` via cloud-sql-proxy, `--token` auth —
the host ADC file is corrupt):

- baseline `claim` count **218,402** — identical to the P26.9 endpoint (no drift)
- after the four first runs: **231,297** — **+12,895 net rows**
  (`claims_added` sums 18,265 computed; inserts dedupe on claim
  `content_digest`, `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, so identical claim content
  collapses — the run-row count is the computed total, the spine delta is the
  genuinely-new total)
- NYC re-run (`m2vtk`, ~5 min later): `claims_added` 4,614 again but the live
  CROL slice had shifted → new capture digest → **+279 net** genuinely-new
  claims → **231,576**. Identical content dedupes to zero; changed evidence
  appends new claims — the append-only idempotency contract working as
  designed.
- Hosted claim-producing sources: 41 → **45**.
